name: Suzueda Komachi
source:
Been friends with [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url] since they were kids. Her family runs a bakery.

She is the "[url=https://vndb.org/g111]Onee-San[/url]" of the group of childhood friends composed of [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c2728]Tomone[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c2726]Yuzuna[/url].

She does not like her breasts ( which is not the case of [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuu-Kun[/url] ), which she finds too big [spoiler]( F cup )[/spoiler]. 

[spoiler]She gave her first kiss to [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url] ( and took his ) several years ago when they were kids at a "wedding play", next to the "secret base", behind the temple.

She is very shy and embarrassed when talking about sex. She knows a bit about H stuff by watching the "[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pornographic_magazine]Holy Books[/url]" of her father. [/spoiler]
